name: cropin-knowledge-graph
description: Configuration-assist knowledge graph for Cropin Cloud: ontology, ingestion pipeline, API and viewer

scripts.build:demo: tsx src/cli/index.ts build --source synthetic --tenant demo --out dist/demo/graph.json --pretty --parity
scripts.build:supabase: tsx src/cli/index.ts build --source supabase --mapping mappings/default.yaml --out dist/demo/graph.json --pretty --parity
scripts.build:single: tsx src/cli/index.ts build --source synthetic --tenant demo --out dist/demo/graph.json --inline dist/demo/index.html
scripts.build:fixture: tsx src/cli/index.ts build --source csv --mapping mappings/acme-csv.yaml --out dist/acme/graph.json --pretty
